name: Solitary Cell
narrativeOnEnter: A tiny room, barely two metres across. The walls are padded — old foam, mouldering now — and the single overhead light is caged behind thick wire mesh. There is no window. There is no furniture. There is only the drain in the floor and a hook on the ceiling.

action.text:
The foam padding is rotting, pulling away from the wall in strips. Behind it: bare concrete.

On the concrete, scratched so deep it cut through the foam:

'4031'

And below it:

'They will come back for us. They always come back.'
A rusted metal drain in the centre of the floor. Nothing more. You don't want to think about why it's there.
An iron hook, bolted into the ceiling. No context provided. No context needed.
